items.title: Toronto Development Pipeline
items.finding: Quarterly analytical pipeline combining planning and building-permit stages; address geocoding remains incomplete.

items.title: Toronto Active and Cleared Building Permits
items.finding: Permit history extends to 2000 and exposes application, issue and completion dates plus current/proposed use.
items.use: event clocks, use change, fit-out and completion labels

items.title: Brampton Building Permits FeatureServer
items.finding: Live point layer supports pagination, statistics, distinct values and advanced queries.

items.title: Mississauga Employment Survey and Business Directory
items.finding: Annual survey since 2001; public directory is consent-based and point-in-time, with business address, activity and employment range.
items.use: candidate backbone and longitudinal employment proxies

items.title: Mississauga Site Plan Applications
items.finding: Public GIS service exposes site-plan application boundaries and attributes but warns older records may be missing or inconsistent.

items.title: Positive LMIA Employers
items.finding: Quarterly employer, occupation and business-location history is available from 2014; lists are incomplete and approvals do not prove hires.

items.title: Canadian Importers Database
items.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
items.finding: Lists major importers by product, city and origin using 2023 customs data; includes brokers and only firms representing up to 80 percent of imports.

items.title: CanadaBuys Contract History
items.finding: Federal contract history is downloadable from 2009 onward; OCDS pilot includes tenders, awards and history since 2012.

items.title: Federal Grants and Contributions
items.finding: Recipient, value, program, dates, description and location can expose funded expansion or equipment projects.

items.title: Ontario ECA and EASR Permissions
items.finding: Open permissions data includes business and facility location; applications and amendments can indicate new or upgraded regulated capacity.

items.title: Federal Corporations
items.finding: Active and inactive federal corporations are published as separate CSV resources with an API.

items.title: Health Canada MDEL Listing
items.finding: Contains company ID, licence, company name, address, authorized activities and device classes.

items.title: Natural Health Product Site Licence Holders
items.finding: Daily-updated searchable CSV/PDF contains company, address, licence number and status.

items.title: CFIA Food Export Registers and Lists
items.finding: Establishment and export-eligibility lists expose licensed food facilities and changes in operator, production or product eligibility.

items.title: Health Canada Cannabis Licence Holders
items.finding: Lists cultivators, processors and sellers, licence classes and initial licence dates.

items.title: Longitudinal Business Database Redesign
items.finding: Longitudinal business data require administrative curation, matching, retiming, vintage-consistent industry codes and cleaning.

items.title: Worker Flows and Establishment Turnover
items.finding: Identifier births and deaths frequently reflect restructuring rather than true establishment entry or exit; independent continuity evidence materially improves classification.

items.title: Nowcasting Local Economy with Yelp
items.finding: Contemporaneous online-platform changes can complement lagged government data at fine geography, but require validation against official establishment measures.

items.title: New versus Relocating Firm Accessibility Preferences
items.finding: New and relocating establishments value accessibility differently by sector, supporting separate event and location-choice models.

items.title: Policy Learning with Observational Data
items.finding: Treatment policies can be optimized under constraints using doubly robust scores, but identification assumptions and observational selection remain decisive.

items.title: Doubly Robust Policy Evaluation and Learning
items.finding: Off-policy value estimation benefits from combining reward and logging-policy models; historical action propensities must be recorded.

items.title: Multiconstraint Team Orienteering with Time Windows
items.finding: Profitable visit selection and sequencing can be solved jointly under route length, service time, time windows and additional constraints.

items.title: Dynamic Orienteering on Queues
items.finding: Stochastic wait and service times justify dynamic recourse rather than treating a route as fixed after issue.

items.title: Robust Team Orienteering with Decreasing Profits
items.finding: Robust routes can materially reduce deadline violations with modest expected-profit loss under service-time uncertainty.

items.title: Toronto Industrial Q2 2026
items.finding: GTA availability held at 5.0 percent, absorption was positive and asking rents continued declining more slowly.

items.title: Toronto Industrial Q2 2026
items.finding: Colliers reported Toronto industrial vacancy at 2.2 percent and positive absorption; metric definitions differ from CBRE availability.

items.title: Toronto Employment Survey 2025/2026
items.finding: Annual establishment survey has operated since 1983, but establishment responses are confidential and public releases are aggregate; 2025 counted 74,560 establishments.
items.use: aggregate sector/geographic context and denominator checks, not an open establishment-level candidate backbone

items.title: Open Database of Businesses
items.finding: Version 1.0 contains about 450,000 harmonized records primarily collected May–December 2022 and explicitly does not cover all Canadian businesses.
items.use: entity seeds and coverage comparison only; not a current complete universe

items.title: Job Postings Advertised on Canada's National Job Bank Website
items.finding: Monthly downloadable posting files include location, postal code, NAICS, occupation, first posting date and vacancy count.
items.use: prospective hiring-pressure evidence after employer, duplicate, remote and staffing-agency controls

items.title: Canadian Business Counts, December 2025
items.finding: Semiannual location counts are available by industry and employment size, but Statistics Canada warns that methodological changes mean changes are not pure business-population time series.
items.use: aggregate denominators and coverage diagnostics with methodological-change controls

items.title: Ontario Business Registry
items.finding: Basic business information is publicly searchable, while detailed products are ordered individually for fees; no open bulk feed was verified.
items.use: manual or targeted legal-entity verification, aliases and status

items.title: OnLand Terms of Use
items.finding: Standard access is record-by-record for prescribed fees, grants limited internal-use rights and restricts merging content with another system unless expressly permitted.
items.use: manual specialized due diligence only unless a separate licence explicitly permits automated integration
